pages.title: Rendering
pages.text: Living things leave more than flesh. Dissolved in distortion fluid, $(item)mob essences$() render into $(thing)liquid experience$().
A crystal turns over the obsidian, tended by a soul. A remnant the void left behind, taking any shape. I gave this one a purpose. It is not the only one.

pages.name: Rendering Cauldron
pages.text: A witch's hut open to the sky, the core in its back wall.

pages.title: The Hut
pages.text: A wide door under slabs, beams crossing over the room to hold the wormhole, an obsidian pedestal beneath it and a cauldron on each side.$(br2)I set the core from inside, facing the door.

pages.title: Its Price
pages.text: Each essence costs 100 measures of fluid and 10 DE. The humblest gives 2 experience, and each tier above gives three times more. 2, 6, 18, 54...$(br2)The side cauldrons show the fluid and the experience.

pages.title: Drinking
pages.text: The experience can be drawn off by bucket or pipe, or drunk straight from its window, one level at a time or all at once.$(br2)But I found better ways to take it. Like every core, it starves without a $(l:energy/wormholes)wormhole$() above it.
A tap on any stone of the cauldron. Opened, it pours up to 20 points a second, a stream of orbs falling like water. Closed, it holds.

pages.title: Bottling
pages.text: An empty bottle held to the tap fills into a $(item)bottle o' enchanting$(), for 10 points of the cauldron's experience.
I touch the cauldron with it to bind the two, and the soul there takes my shape. To unbind it, I crouch and use it on empty air.

pages.title: Mending
pages.text: Carried, or worn as a charm, it mends anything I own that knows Mending, from the cauldron's experience, wherever I am, as long as the cauldron's land is awake.$(br2)Each cauldron answers only one of us.
